#### Pharmacokinetics: (not sure if would score marks)

+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Administration | - Hypotension: bolus 1-10 units, infusion 0.1-1 units/minute         |
|                | - Arrest: bolus 40 units                                             |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Time course    | - Onset \<1 min                                                      |
|                | - Duration 20-40 minutes for vascular effect, hours for renal effect |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Absorption     | - Minimal (digested by peptidases)                                   |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Distribution   | - Plasma protein binding 10-40%                                      |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Metabolism     | - Peptidases in liver, kidneys; then recycled                        |
|                | - t~1/2~~β~ 10-20 minutes                                            |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Excretion      | - Some renal excretion                                               |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Pharmacodynamics:

+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Mechanism of action | - Oxytocin receptor: G~q~ G protein coupled receptor                   |
|                     | - ↑IP~3~/Ca^2+^, ↑DAG                                                  |
+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| V1                  | - Vascular smooth muscle                                               |
|                     | - Generalised vasoconstriction → ↑SVR \> ↑PVR                          |
+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| V2                  | - Late distal tubule and collecting duct                               |
|                     |   - Insertion of aquaporin-2 into apical membrane; endothelium         |
|                     | - Endothelium                                                          |
|                     |   - Release of vWF                                                     |
+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| V3                  | - Anterior pituitary                                                   |
|                     | - ↑ACTH → ↑cortisol                                                    |
+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Use                 | - Cardiac arrest (alternative to adrenaline)                           |
|                     | - 2^nd^ line for vasoplegia (e.g. sepsis, post-cardiopulmonary bypass) |
+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Side effects        | - Mild ↑PVR                                                            |
|                     | - Oxytocin-like effects                                                |
+---------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
